context: A boss and his manager read evening headlines
purpose: Teach: 暴露/罰金/原爆/仮面/陸軍/煙草/交際/県立

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: おい、夕刊見たか？大物議員の交際相手が暴露されてるぞ。
lines.en: Hey, did you see the evening paper? A big-shot politician's relationship has been exposed.
lines.style: Gruff senior boss reading headlines aloud sharply

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: ええ、読みました。しかも違法献金で罰金まで科されるそうですね。
lines.en: Yes, I read it. On top of that, he's apparently being fined for illegal donations.
lines.style: Polite middle-manager responding with measured concern

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: まったく、ああいう連中はみんな仮面をかぶってやがる。
lines.en: Honestly, those types are all wearing masks, every one of them.
lines.style: Cynical older boss grumbling with weary disgust

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 次のページには、広島の原爆ドーム周辺で記念式典が開かれたとあります。
lines.en: On the next page, it says a memorial ceremony was held around the Hiroshima A-bomb Dome.
lines.style: Manager shifting tone to somber respectful reporting

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: そうか…俺の親父も旧陸軍にいたから、ああいう記事は胸にくるな。
lines.en: Is that so... My old man was in the former army too, so articles like that hit me hard.
lines.style: Boss softening, reflective and quietly emotional

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: それと、県立高校で煙草を吸った生徒が処分されたという記事もありますよ。
lines.en: Also, there's an article about students being disciplined for smoking at a prefectural high school.
lines.style: Polite manager continuing news rundown with mild amusement

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: ふん、こっちは大人の汚職、向こうはガキの煙草か。世も末だな。
lines.en: Hmph, adults with corruption on one side, kids with cigarettes on the other. The world's gone to hell.
lines.style: Boss scoffing with sarcastic resigned humor

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 本当に。明日の朝刊も、また何かの暴露記事で埋まりそうですね。
lines.en: Truly. Tomorrow's morning paper will probably be filled with more exposé articles again.
lines.style: Manager closing with dry resigned agreement
